app.name: Otiyot

menu.title: Main menu

track.title: Choose how you learn
track.lead: Both tracks teach the whole keyboard and end in the same place. They differ in how the first letters arrive.
track.body1: You meet one new letter at a time, beginning with the home row where your fingers rest. Each letter is practised on its own before the next one joins.
track.body2: You learn two letters in every lesson, the most common ones first, and you are typing real words by the third lesson.
track.p1b: Calm and thorough: best if touch typing is new to you
track.p1c: Words come once the letters feel familiar
track.p2c: Best if you already type a little, or drills bore you
track.note: You can switch at any time. Progress is kept separately for each track, and what the game has learned about your fingers is shared by both.

lesson.label: Lesson

lesson.needs: Reach 90% accuracy to pass and open the next lesson. Slow and right beats fast.
meadow.options.noTimers: Nothing in the Meadow counts down, on any difficulty. Harder ones ask for longer words and forgive fewer slips; the Sofer’s Trial ends at the first one.
meadow.results.restored: The Meadow is restored. Its beacon is lit on the map in the house.
cliffs.options.noTimers: Nothing on the Cliffs counts down, on any difficulty. Harder ones ask for longer words and forgive fewer slips; the Sofer’s Trial ends at the first one.
cliffs.results.restored: The Cliffs are restored. Their beacon is lit on the map in the house.
region.blot.place: The Silent Arena: everything the Fading took has gathered into one great blot.
hub.need.after: First defeat {region} in the Silent Arena.
arena.phase.how.p1: Single words: each one bursts a glob in the air.
arena.phase.how.p2: Sentences: a whole sentence cuts a tendril.
arena.phase.how.p3: A passage: keep typing to hold back the ink.
arena.phase.how.p4: The mirror: the stolen words come back, last first.
arena.options.timers: On Calm nothing reaches you: the attacks come close and wait. On harder difficulties an attack lands if you stop for long, and your streak drops. Calm, Steady and Swift keep a checkpoint at every new phase; the Sofer’s Trial ends at the first slip.
arena.results.restored: The Great Blot is undone and the Silent Arena is restored. The road of Act Two is open on the map.
scroll.phase.how.c1: Single words: each one draws the meadow and the cliffs back onto the page.
scroll.phase.how.c2: Words with the marks you know: a slip gives ground back to the white.
scroll.phase.how.c3: Bursts of words at speed, and a breath after each burst.
scroll.phase.how.c4: Sentences on a swinging tide: fast when it rises, easy when it falls.
scroll.phase.how.c5: One long passage: a clean hand keeps the lantern lit.
scroll.phase.how.k1: Single words fill the great page. When Naftali or Reb Ezra calls a word, type it clean.
scroll.phase.how.k2: Sentences, a little faster: the last word of each is an ally's call.
scroll.phase.how.k3: One quiet passage on a slow tide: slips give ground.
scroll.phase.how.k4: His lost words: write them back faster than he erases. A clean call writes back what he wiped.
scroll.call: {name} calls a word: type it clean!
scroll.credits.title: Sign your work

scroll.credits.2: A typing adventure in the Land of Letters
scroll.credits.3: With Reb Ezra, Naftali, Dyo and the Keeper
scroll.credits.4: From the Home Row Meadow to the Blank Scroll: every region restored
scroll.credits.5: Every picture, tune and word was made for this scroll
scroll.credits.6: Written by the ten fingers of {name}
scroll.credits.7: Thank you for writing. The quill is yours.
scroll.results.written: The Blank Scroll is written and the Land of Letters is whole: you have finished the story. New Game+ is unlocked on this profile, and every region stays open to play again for a higher rank.
trials.title: The Trials of the Arena
trials.lead: Three bosses wait on the old stage, each testing a different skill. Beat all three to restore the Silent Arena.
trials.keys: Press 1, 2 or 3 to fight a trial. Esc goes back to the house.
trials.whole: All three trials are beaten: the Silent Arena is restored, and the way to the Blank Scroll is open.
trials.storm.about: A hawk of thundercloud with a crest of lightning. It strikes in quick bursts and rests between them: type fast, breathe, type fast again.
trials.glass.about: A golem of cut glass. Slow, but every slip mends one of its cracks. A clean hand wins here, not a quick one.
trials.tide.about: A great wave that never tires. Long passages, and a tide that comes fast and then slows. Keep an even pace to the end.
trials.storm.how.p1: Words in pairs: finish each pair before the spark lands.
trials.storm.how.p2: Longer bursts, a faster pace. Breathe when it rests.
trials.storm.how.p3: Quick sentences at the height of the storm.
trials.glass.how.p1: Single words. Every slip mends a crack; a perfect word dazzles it.
trials.glass.how.p2: Sentences: the longest word is where the glass is thinnest.
trials.glass.how.p3: A passage. Slow and sure: every slip still heals it.
trials.tide.how.p1: A long passage. At high tide the wave comes faster; at low tide it slows.
trials.tide.how.p2: Sentences: each one breaks a wave.
trials.tide.how.p3: The longest passage of all. Do not stop, do not rush.
trials.results.beaten: {name} is beaten. Its rank is on the trials board.
trials.results.whole: All three trials are beaten: the Silent Arena is restored, and the way to the Blank Scroll is open on the map.
sound.mood.forge: A hammering groove, oud and cello with taiko on the anvil beat
forge.options.noTimers: Nothing in the Forge counts down, on any difficulty. A fire that is too low or too high only dulls a letter. Harder ones ask for longer numbers and forgive fewer slips; the Sofer’s Trial ends at the first one.
forge.results.restored: The Forge is restored. Its fire is lit on the map in the house.
forge.empty: The Forge needs the number row first.
sound.mood.shuk: A swinging, chattering groove, kanun and clarinet over a frame drum with a bell for every coin
shuk.options.noTimers: Nothing in the Shuk counts down, on any difficulty. A slip only breaks your streak of clean deals. Harder ones ask for more kinds of marks and forgive fewer slips; the Sofer’s Trial ends at the first one.
shuk.results.restored: The Night Shuk is restored. Its lanterns are lit on the map in the house.
sound.mood.rail: A driving dorian groove, a chugging kanun like pistons under a bright harp and clarinet, brushes on the snare
rail.options.noTimers: Nothing on the Line counts down, on any difficulty. A slip only takes some of your boost. Harder ones forgive fewer slips; the Sofer’s Trial ends at the first one.
rail.results.restored: The Jaffa Line is restored. Its lamps are lit on the map in the house.
geniza.chapter.finale: The hall is in the light
geniza.options.noTimers: Nothing in the Geniza counts down, on any difficulty. An even beat lifts the pages faster; a rush only stirs the silt. Harder ones forgive fewer slips; the Sofer’s Trial ends at the first one.
geniza.results.restored: The Sunken Geniza is restored. Its light shines on the map in the house.
sound.mood.geniza: Slow and swaying like water in a hall, a singing cello over a rolling harp, deep echo
sound.mood.hermon: Soaring in three, a horn calling over rolling rain, strings and thunder drums
hermon.options.noTimers: On Calm the hailstones stop in the air and wait for you. On the others a stone falls as you type; if it reaches the eagle the streak drops and it comes down again, slower. Nothing ends the flight except the Sofer’s Trial, at the first slip.
hermon.results.restored: Wings over Hermon is restored. Its light shines on the map in the house.
sound.mood.station: Weightless and slow, a glass harmonica singing the stars over a twinkling harp
sound.mood.atbash: Rain on neon: a synth pluck singing like a code machine over bells for the signs flickering back on
station.options.noTimers: Every module is two sentences: the first fires your thrusters and floats you to its hatch, the second works its turret against the debris. On Calm the rocks stop and wait for you. On the others a rock comes in as you type; if it reaches the hull the streak drops and it comes in again, slower. Nothing ends the run except the Sofer’s Trial, at the first slip.
station.results.restored: The Star Station is restored. Its light shines on the map in the house.
atbash.options.noTimers: Every gate is two codes: first the cipher, whose sign shows the code in atbash (the alphabet turned backward) and turns back letter by letter as you type it; then the sequence, two codes in a pattern that turns the rings of the lock. While you type, a patrol drone flies its round. On Calm it never comes back. On the others, if it comes back before the code is done its light finds you: the streak drops and it goes round again, slower. Nothing ends the run except the Sofer’s Trial, at the first slip.
atbash.results.restored: Atbash City is restored. Its neon shines on the map in the house.
sound.mood.midbar: A caravan in the sand: a breathy ney tune in B freygish over an oud and a frame drum rocking like a camel’s walk
midbar.options.noTimers: Every stage of the road is two sentences: a clear one, where the next words stand on the stones ahead, and a sandstorm, where the stones vanish and you can only see the word you are typing (on Easy, one word more). In the storm every word brings a gust of sand. On Calm the gusts stop and wait for you. On the others, if a gust reaches the caravan before the word is done, the streak drops and it comes again, slower. Nothing ends the run except the Sofer’s Trial, at the first slip.
midbar.results.restored: The Long Midbar is restored. Its oasis shines on the map in the house.
sound.mood.caves: Careful steps in the dark: a kalimba picking its way through E mi sheberach over a hushed harp, a low cello and soft brushes
sound.mood.final: An empty page filling up: a santur alone in D minor, then cello, bells and a frame drum joining column by column, and everything at full stride for the Keeper's lost words
caves.options.noTimers: Every chamber of the caves is one passage of words. Every right letter feeds your lantern and a clean streak makes it flare, so the shadows shrink back; every stumble dims it, and they creep closer. A bright lantern also shows the next words on the chalk ahead; a dim one shows only the word you are typing. On Calm the flame never goes out. On the others it burns down slowly while you type, and if the light goes out the shadows touch you: the streak drops, the lantern is lit again and burns slower. Nothing ends the run except the Sofer’s Trial, at the first slip.
caves.results.restored: The Lantern Caves are restored. Their lamps shine on the map in the house.
sound.mood.ladder: Up and up above the clouds: a marimba hopping up G dorian like feet on rungs, a shimmering santur, wide strings and a darbuka that keeps the climb going
ladder.loading: Raising the tower above the clouds…
ladder.chip.fall: Down in the clouds from floor {n}
ladder.options.rest: Rest here and keep my height
ladder.options.howTo: The Ladder has no top. Every floor is a small challenge from another place: a gale, a cloud bank that hides the next word, glass rungs, long words or a swarm of Blots. Every right letter firms your grip; a slip loosens it. On Calm your grip never gives out, so rest whenever you like. On the others it tires as you climb, faster the higher you go; the first time it gives out Dyo catches you, the second time you drop softly into the clouds and the climb ends. Every fifth floor is a landing that gives you your strength back. Modifiers make the climb harder and the score higher.

ladder.mod.brittle.tip: Every slip costs more grip. Score ×1.25

modes.title: Ways to play
modes.lead: Drills and challenges built only from the letters you have learned.
modes.label: Modes
modes.mode.practice.body: Targeted drills on a clean screen: your weak keys, what is due for review, a lesson of your course, or your own words.
modes.mode.timeattack.body: Type as many words as you can before the clock runs out. A clean run beats a fast, sloppy one.
modes.mode.survival.body: Your grip tires as you go. Finished words give it back, mistakes cost it. Cross the distance before it gives out.
modes.mode.daily.body: One set of words and modifiers for each date, the same whenever you play it that day. Your best is kept on this device.
modes.lessonsBody: The course itself lives here too.
modes.noLetters: Learn a few letters first. Every mode uses only the letters you know.
modes.practice.customHint: Type or paste words. Only words made of letters you have learned are used.
modes.practice.fallback: Nothing stands out yet, so this is a general drill of your letters.
modes.practice.empty: None of those words use only the letters you have learned yet.
modes.mod.noLookahead.body: The next word stays hidden until you reach it.
modes.mod.fog.body: The letters still to come are blurred.
modes.mod.sudden.body: The keyboard guide vanishes without warning a few words in.

modes.rule.survival.calm: Cross {n} words, your grip never tires
